title: senna cumingii var. coquimbensis
intro: Senna cumingii var. coquimbensis, commonly known as Chilean senna, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include treating constipation, diarrhea, and various gastrointestinal issues due to its laxative effects. The therapeutic actions of Chilean senna are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable remedy for digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Chilean senna include anthraquinone glycosides, which are responsible for its laxative properties.
